data.text: I’m with Jack and John: I’ll commit to 10 tons if all five of us agree. Luke, as our newest neighbor, you deserve an equal share—not a smaller one—but taking everything would leave you without a livelihood here too. We can’t preserve the lake without your cooperation. Let’s keep at least 50 tons in the water and check the revealed catches together each month. Emma, will you join that agreement? Then we need Luke’s answer before anyone heads out.
